cohort: Late preterm infants (LPIs) delivered at an academic center in Jordan over a 5-year period
finding: Several maternal and perinatal factors were associated with longer initial hospital stay in LPIs, but late discharge did not lower the rate of readmission.
mod_finding: C-section delivery was associated with a longer hospital stay (AOR 2.4, 95% C.I 1.9, 3, p 0.001).
